concerns.text: FR-015 claims that a Pearson correlation |ρ| ≤ 0.2 between GNN residuals and baseline residuals indicates *independence* of the two error sources. Correlation only measures linear association and does not guarantee statistical independence; the claim could be false without additional justification.

FR-007 specifies a paired t‑test on per‑molecule absolute errors. The t‑test assumes the differences are approximately normally distributed, but no normality check or alternative non‑parametric test (e.g., Wilcoxon signed‑rank) is mentioned. This may invalidate the significance assessment.

The attribution validation plan (FR-011) proposes correlating Integrated Gradients scores with Hammett σ constants, yet most QM9 molecules lack experimentally measured σ values. The spec does not describe how missing σ data will be handled or how a representative, unbiased subset will be constructed, risking selection bias and undermining construct validity of the attribution analysis.
